name: Economy: market
description: Phase 5 bot market. Step 5a: the market item catalogue (Living Worlds allow-list + shots and potions, with grade, NPC price, NPC-sold and stage from stock data), the price index of real private store deals (hook P5-STORE-DEAL, API 1.3), the trade log, the server stage 1-5 and the price model (base from the NPC price and stage, blend with the index, solo drift, seller and buyer prices); //market. In online it only keeps the trade log and the index (invisible to players). Steps 5b/5c (with bots-core): bot traders stand at the store places of a town while a real player is near (persona, name, kind and sign kept per place), SELL, PACKAGE_SELL and BUY stores, life on paper while away, night offline look, wallets, resale of bought goods, daily limits of selling to bots; //market traders.

Market.description: Bot market (auto = on in solo, off in online): bot traders and buyers (steps 5b-5f). Off = only the trade log and the price index of real deals.

MarketStage.description: Server stage 1-5 (what bot stores carry: 1 no grade/D, shots, potions; 2 D/C; 3 C/B; 4 B/A; 5 A and single S) or auto: solo by the highest level of the real characters and hours played, online by days since start and the average level of the top 10.

PriceMultiplier.description: All bot prices x this (like LW FakePlayerStorePriceMultiplier).

SellMarkup.description: Bot sellers ask market price x min..max by their greed.

BuyBid.description: Bot buyers bid market price x min..max (stingy..generous); always below the cheapest bot seller.

NpcArbitrageGuard.description: Bots never buy an NPC-sold item dearer than this share of the NPC price (and never sell it below the NPC price).

BotAdenaPerPlayerDay.description: Step 5d: adena bots may pay real players per player and day, as a share of an hour of farming at the player's level.

SellToBotsItemDay.description: Step 5d: pieces of one item a player may sell to bots per day (x10 for cheap stackables).

StoresPerTown.description: Bot store places per town (step 5b). For now only Giran has stores; the other towns are ready and get places when their number is above 0.

SimulatedDrift.description: auto = on in solo, off in online. Prices drift slowly (at most 10 % around the market, a new value each week) where real deals are too few, like in solo.

TradeLogDays.description: Days the trade log keeps a deal.

Seed.description: Seed of the price drift; 0 = derived from the database.

TraderLingerSeconds.description: Bot traders stay this long after the last player left the market (a player who steps out and back sees the same stores).

WatchRadius.description: A real player this close to the middle of a town's store places brings the traders.

NightStay.description: At night (1:00-7:59 server time) this share of the traders keeps the store open with the grey name of an offline store; the others are away.

SelfTest.description: Smoke test only: once stores stand, one bot buys from a bot sell store and sells to a bot buy store through the stock store code and the result is logged (SELFTEST).
